title: Sea of Chaos: Flag Raiders
tagline: A free-for-all pirate arcade game. Steal the Skull Flag, race it to your personal buoy, and stash three flags before rival captains do.

roles.name: Captain
roles.description: Sail solo against rival captains or host/join a free-for-all with a 4-letter room code.

multiplayer.notes: Every captain is a rival. The host simulates at 30 Hz and broadcasts state at 10 Hz; clients send controls at 20 Hz. Up to 8 humans may join; AI fills the roster to 6 captains when space allows. Two Sea Raiders hunt the flag carrier. Solo play uses the same rules against AI.

requires: keyboard and mouse or touch controls
